cohort: The study included three groups of pregnant women: healthy women, women with arterial hypertension, and women with arterial hypertension and hypothyroidism.
finding: Women with arterial hypertension consumed the highest number of calories, fat, cholesterol, and carbohydrates daily, while women with arterial hypertension and hypothyroidism more frequently gave birth before the 38th week of pregnancy.
gest_age: Birth before 38th week of pregnancy was an outcome, but specific gestational age of the cohort was not mentioned.
